description: Capacidade de Armazenamento dos Reservatórios is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). A partir da base de dados de massas d'água, foi calculada a capacidade total de armazenamento de cerca de 3.661 reservatórios, totalizando 630,2 bilhões de m³ no País, 92,7% deste total representado pelos reservatórios para geração de energia hidrelétrica. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are massa d'água, reservatório, UGRH, hidrelétrica, SNIRH. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
